steps.what: Advise patients about diet, activity, hygiene and disease prevention

tasks.design: Keep the advice conversation with the physician. Vetted patient information in {OTHER}, a patient information service, can support explanations without replacing assessment of individual circumstances.
tasks.previous_blocker: Prevention advice depends on health literacy, preferences and competing illnesses.
tasks.enabler_now: Guideline-based patient information is available, but does not establish shorter conversations.
tasks.still_hard: Checking understanding and negotiating realistic changes.
tasks.human_edge: The physician adapts advice to the person and notices misunderstanding.
tasks.altitude: Conversation time and clinical decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Referral criteria and scope of dietary assessment

evidence.claim: Thuisarts provides guideline-based patient information; this supports reference material rather than a measured reduction in consultation time.

assumptions: Boundary is personal advice, excluding separate note writing and referral administration.
No structured feed or machine step is assumed; the physician obtains context during the full-time conversation.
Check existing patient-information access before any custom work.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new service, integration or generated advice is deployed.
research_questions: Does access to approved explanations improve understanding without shortening necessary discussion?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; net saving 0. Reference material earns no assumed labour reduction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Compare illnesses, clinical findings and alternative diagnoses
Resolve diagnostic uncertainty or select further investigation

tasks.design: Keep complex diagnostic reasoning and investigation decisions with the physician. The {OTHER} clinical record remains a reference; record search capability alone does not validate diagnostic automation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Ambiguous findings and interacting illnesses defeat simple decision rules.
tasks.enabler_now: Record retrieval may improve access, but the digest provides no validated complex-diagnosis saving.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing competing explanations when evidence is incomplete.
tasks.human_edge: The physician weighs uncertainty and consequences of further investigation.
tasks.altitude: Diagnostic responsibility and time remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Complex multimorbidity diagnosis requires contextual clinical judgement; these time allocations are an E1 decomposition, not an observed saving.

assumptions: Boundary starts with available findings and excludes examination, ordering logistics and note production counted elsewhere.
Existing clinical records are produced by treating clinicians and laboratories; missing or conflicting findings are investigated manually within these full-time steps.
Test native record access first; no custom diagnostic service is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because the diagnostic workflow is unchanged.
research_questions: Which information access delays are separable from clinical reasoning in observed complex cases?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; net 0. No case-specific diagnostic labour saving is established.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Monitor patient conditions and progress against treatment goals
Reevaluate treatments against response, adverse effects and patient preferences

tasks.design: Retain direct assessment and treatment reevaluation by the physician. The {OTHER} clinical record supplies existing results, without treating a dashboard as a substitute for clinical monitoring.
tasks.previous_blocker: Response and adverse effects need patient-specific interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: Electronic results can inform review; their existing runtime is not saved physician labour.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing benefit, side effects and adherence when the picture changes.
tasks.human_edge: The physician interprets subtle deterioration and agrees changes with the patient.
tasks.altitude: Monitoring and treatment authority stay with the physician.

evidence.claim: Clinical monitoring includes interpretation and treatment judgement; a dashboard alone does not establish a shorter review.

assumptions: Boundary is assessment and treatment reconsideration, excluding separate record drafting and prescription processing.

Physician produces the progress assessment in s1; existing laboratory and nursing findings retain their current capture effort outside this boundary. Missing observations require direct assessment, not an assumed feed.
Check native record views before adding any dashboard; none is introduced here.
Zero incremental upkeep because no changed software or observation protocol is introduced.
unknowns: Monitoring frequency and access to observations
research_questions: How much monitoring time is clinical interpretation rather than finding existing results?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; net 0. Patient review and treatment reconsideration retain their full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Collect medical history, reports and examination results into an encounter brief
Draft patient information in the clinical record

loop.purpose: Draft a note from supplied clinical facts without inventing findings
loop.output: Draft note linked to source facts with unresolved gaps
loop.check: Physician compares meaning, negation, chronology, medication details and uncertainty with the brief; unsupported facts are removed
loop.stop: One correction pass, then manual drafting for missing or contradictory facts
loop.why_not_simpler: Clinical narrative varies and fixed field substitution cannot produce a faithful account

steps.what: Verify and file the final patient record version

tasks.design: Use a bounded draft facility within the {OTHER} clinical record after the physician supplies the encounter facts. The physician checks the meaning and signs the exact final note; no diagnosis, order or medication change is released by drafting.
tasks.previous_blocker: Clinical facts arrive as mixed reports and narrative accounts.
tasks.enabler_now: Clinical documentation drafting with clinician validation exists; local input quality still determines the return.
tasks.still_hard: Preserving uncertainty, source attribution and clinically important negatives.
tasks.human_edge: The physician distinguishes confirmed findings from reported symptoms and interpretations.
tasks.altitude: Less note composition while clinical verification and signing remain explicit work.

evidence.claim: Autoscriber drafts consultation records for clinician validation and transfer to clinical systems. This supports the capability, not the local saving estimate or this exact brief-based input design.
The brief-based workflow and time split are model-knowledge design assumptions requiring a local pilot.

assumptions: Boundary covers collecting and writing one encounter record, excluding diagnostic reasoning, patient counselling and review decisions counted separately.

Physician produces the encounter brief during s1, including patient identifier, encounter date, symptom timing, reported history, examination findings, source document identifiers and uncertainty. Collection, brief capture and any dictation time are inside the unchanged 45 hours; if that is insufficient, expand the baseline estimate before claiming savings.
No clean structured feed is assumed. Unclear source material is read and entered manually within s1; s2 drafts only from supplied facts.
Test native record templates and supported draft facilities before custom integration. No ambient recording is assumed.
Incremental quality sampling and template maintenance add 4 physician hours and 2 medical records specialist hours per 100 baseline physician hours.
unknowns: Supported record draft interface and access
Local consultation and data governance requirements
research_questions: Does drafting reduce total physician time after brief capture, corrections, signing and quality sampling?

already_counted.description: Correct the draft for clinical meaning

approvals.approved_version: Exact final note text, patient identifier, encounter identifier and source links; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=45+18+25=88; gross 12 less 4 focal upkeep gives central net 8. Low 2 allows six additional correction hours on complex histories. Clinical collection and final signing stay unchanged; E1 scenarios.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep clinical judgement and conversations; reduce only encounter note composition where a measured pilot supports it.
reach: Coordinate record-quality checks with medical records specialists
role.ambitious_version: A physician with faithful records and explicit uncertainty, without delegated clinical decisions.
